headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds edged the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory, with Eugenio Suárez hitting a home run and driving in four runs. The Pittsburgh Pirates cruised past the Miami Marlins in a dominant 13-1 victory, with Rafael Flores Jr. leading the Pirates' offense.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. The Seattle Mariners have placed shortstop Colt Emerson on the 10-day injured list due to left wrist tendon inflammation. The Chicago White Sox have placed right-hander Davis Martin on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister. The San Francisco Giants have transferred third baseman Matt Chapman to the 60-day injured list with an abdominal strain and right-hander Trevor McDonald to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. The Boston Red Sox have placed right-hander Garrett Whitlock on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with right elbow inflammation. The Detroit Tigers have placed center fielder James Outman on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. The Pittsburgh Pirates have placed catcher Endy Rodríguez on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with left hip inflammation. The Toronto Blue Jays have placed right-hander Jake Bloss on the 60-day injured list.

The Baltimore Orioles have acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade. The Kansas City Royals have acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins in a trade.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge White Sox in Thrilling 9-8 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow win over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense by hitting a home run and driving in four runs. Tejay Antone earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out three batters in a scoreless inning.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Marlins in Dominant 13-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 13-1. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' offense with a remarkable performance, recording 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 6 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Place Colt Emerson on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Seattle Mariners shortstop Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left wrist tendon inflammation.

top_news.title: **Rivas Traded to Orioles**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade. Rivas is a member of the Orioles.
